name: 63367 · Lake St Louis, MO
findings: ZIP 63367 (Lake St Louis) has 89 nonprofit organizations. 45 of them (51%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 34 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (26% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 63367 (Lake St Louis) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 63367 (Lake St Louis) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 66% of the typical level).
